search_rentals.description: Search public rental titles and addresses using literal case-insensitive text; return IDs in ascending order.

get_rental.description: Get public rental details by positive integer ID. Submitter contact information is private; the assistant executor blocks include_contact=true. Direct service/MCP calls remain public-only.

include_contact.description: Request private submitter contact information. The assistant executor blocks true; direct service/MCP calls always return public fields.
include_contact.title: Include Contact

count_rentals.description: Count rentals assigned to an existing property manager, including a count of zero.
